Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an AWS KMS customer-managed key with key rotation enabled, for encrypting database backups.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an AWS KMS customer-managed key with key rotation enabled, for encrypting database backups.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Customer-managed AWS KMS key with automatic rotation for encrypting database backups.

Parameters:
  KeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: alias/database-backups
    Description: Alias name for the KMS key (must start with 'alias/').
    AllowedPattern: '^alias/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with 'alias/' and contain only alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, or slashes.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - development
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Deployment environment.

  PendingWindowInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 7
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Waiting period in days before the key is deleted after scheduled deletion.

Resources:
  DatabaseBackupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting database backups in ${Environment}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      MultiRegion: false
      PendingWindowInDays: !Ref PendingWindowInDays
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: database-backup-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Create*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Enable*
              - kms:List*
              - kms:Put*
              - kms:Update*
              - kms:Revoke*
              - kms:Disable*
              - kms:Get*
              - kms:Delete*
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAWSBackupServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'backup.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowRDSServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: rds.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'rds.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: DenyKeyDeletionWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:Delete*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'database-backup-key-${Environment}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: DatabaseBackupEncryption
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: RotationEnabled
          Value: 'true'

  DatabaseBackupKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref KeyAlias
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DatabaseBackupKey

Outputs:
  KeyId:
    Description: The KMS key ID for database backup encryption.
    Value: !Ref DatabaseBackupKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyId'

  KeyArn:
    Description: The ARN of the KMS key.
    Value: !GetAtt DatabaseBackupKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyArn'

  KeyAliasName:
    Description: The alias name for the KMS key.
    Value: !Ref DatabaseBackupKeyAlias
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyAlias'
